title: Pitta Dosha Complete Guide
introduction: Pitta dosha represents transformation and metabolism in the body. It controls digestion, body temperature, hormones, and intellect. When balanced, Pitta promotes intelligence, confidence, and strong digestion. When imbalanced, it can lead to anger, acidity, and inflammation.
what_is_pitta:
Pitta dosha is one of the three fundamental energies in Ayurveda and is primarily composed of the elements of fire (Agni) and water (Jal). It governs all metabolic and transformative processes in the body, including digestion, absorption, assimilation, and body temperature regulation. Pitta is responsible for converting food into energy and also plays a key role in maintaining sharp intellect and decision-making abilities.This dosha has qualities like heat, sharpness, intensity, liquidity, and slight oiliness. When in balance, Pitta supports strong digestion, clarity of thought, leadership qualities, and confidence. It also helps maintain healthy skin tone and good vision.

However, Pitta can become imbalanced due to excessive heat, spicy or oily food, stress, anger, or overworking. When disturbed, it can lead to issues such as acidity, heartburn, skin rashes, excessive sweating, irritability, and anger.Maintaining balance in Pitta is essential for proper digestion, emotional stability, and overall vitality. A calm and balanced Pitta promotes focus, strength, and healthy metabolism.
remedies: Avoid spicy, oily, and fried food
Practice meditation to reduce anger and stress
Drink plenty of water and cooling drinks
